quote: Okay. Well, yeah. I mean, we're we're not able to do that here, so I'll just take you off my list.
stewart_read: Call ends on rep's concession with no second rebuttal angle attempted first. Given the customer's explicit and repeated ultimatum, this was a low-winnability call, but the rep still closed without trying an alternative (e.g., a shorter ask, or offering to have someone send general program info by email as a middle ground) before letting go.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic read: rep may have judged further push was pointless given two explicit ultimatums and cut losses efficiently rather than burn more time on an unwinnable lead. Evidence for this reading exists (customer's own repeated 'no problem' language suggests he was already checked out), but the rep never tested a second angle to confirm that judgment.
coaching_implication: Distinguish for the rep between 'this call was low-winnability' (true) and 'I should stop trying after one angle' (still a gap) — even unwinnable calls are where reps build the rebuttal reps that pay off on winnable ones.
